ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The fluke surface presents a high-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) base covering approximately 80% of the visible area, with high-intensity (white) mottling and streaks concentrated along the distal edges and right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patch on the upper-right distal lobe; localized white mottling along the trailing edge of the left lobe; numerous thin white linear streaks distributed across the central dark regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, sharp peaks and valleys; serration amplitude is highest on the outer one-third of both lobes, transitioning to more subtle oscillations near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a strong convex curve, sweeping superiorly and laterally from the notch towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel formations (barnacle colonization) are located at the extreme terminal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected across the central and proximal areas of both lobes, cutting through the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the entire visible ventral surface; heavy calcified clusters (barnacles) at both distal tips; significant irregular white scarring on the upper right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique semi-circular white mark resembling the letter 'C' located in the lower-central low-intensity region of the right lobe.
